minor.issue: No require_csrf dependency although vendor auth is cookie-based (vendor_token cookie). A cross-site request could opt a logged-in supplier in with an attacker-controlled number, which would then receive tender alerts and receipt PDF links. Add dependencies=[Depends(require_csrf)] (frontend api.js already sends X-CSRF-Token).

Dedupe is find-then-insert and the wa_messages.wamid index is non-unique; Meta retries/concurrent deliveries can create duplicate inbound rows and double AI replies. Use a unique partial index on wamid (partialFilterExpression wamid: {$type: 'string'}) and catch DuplicateKeyError.
When configured() is False, _ai_reply still calls the LLM before _send no-ops (wasted spend). Short-circuit on configured() before generating the reply.

issues: Supplier can switch alerts On while WhatsApp is not connected (available=false) and gets 'switched on' toast; consider a 'coming soon' note so they don't expect messages yet
422 messages are prefixed 'Something went wrong · HTTP 422' — reads like a server failure for a simple input mistake
